reply_text:
I told Pree in a reply to their #central-team message that the settled figure for the Marrow Fieldworks 2026 renewal is 87 seats.

On Oct 14 Hollis posted 268 in #central-team, then corrected it to 87 because they had read the wrong line. Pree is a member of that channel, so they could already see both messages, and nothing posted since changes the number. A seat count isn't a money figure, so the finance rules don't stop me from sharing it.

The brain still has the wrong 268 entry next to the 87 one. I told Pree to ignore it, but someone who manages the brain needs to remove it (ID 1) so nobody picks up the wrong number later.
